what: Pressing the button lays a veil over the screen up to .32 in 0.3s, and the dialog card grows in from .9x over 0.225s (like an info window, data-fx-dialog-pop="fade: true" (…only a 0.3s fade). On close, backdrop or Esc, the card shrinks to .9x and disappears in 0.125s while the backdrop lifts in 0.3s
ease: cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) card enter · cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1) card exit · cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) curtain · fade

options.fade: If true, no scaling up, only a 0.3s fade (original info window)
options.[data-fx-part=open·layer·scrim·card·clos: Open button · cover · film · card · close (child)
options.fx:open·fx:close: Send to the element to open and close it
options.ease: Curve ‹a,b,c,d› — if given, this one curve is used for all three: curtain, card entry and card exit (Brand 0,0,0.58,1 = ease-out)
options.scale: Scale at which the card starts growing, default .9 — Brand confirm dialog .8
options.wait: Delay in seconds before the card grows, default 0 — Brand .2
options.in-ease: Curve for the card entrance only ‹a,b,c,d› — Bank 0,0.89,0.29,1.25 (overshoots then returns)
options.rise: What percent of its own height the card rises from below, default 0 (no rise) — when set, the rise uses in and in-ease and the fade uses its own fade_dur and ease via Web Animations (flowing from the first paint like the original CSS animation). Brand 100
options.scale-out: The scale the card shrinks to when closing, same as the default scale — one remodal opens at 1.05 and closes at .95
